name: Happō (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Happō town emblem in green, blue and orange: a green stylised letter K with a blue wave and two orange strokes above.
history: Municipal flag of Happō, a town in Akita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 27 March 2006.

features.role: Happō town emblem — a green stylised letter K with a blue wave and two orange strokes above
